result.anchor_clause: “Specified Subsidiary” means a newly formed wholly-owned Subsidiary of the Co-Borrower, which shall hold no property or assets, other than the JV Interests; provided, that such Subsidiary shall not incur or guarantee any Indebtedness or suffer to exist any Liens (it being understood that failure to comply with this proviso shall constitute an Event of Default).

lme_vectors.rationale: Loan Parties may form only one new direct Subsidiary, the Specified Subsidiary. That subsidiary may hold only the JV Interests and may not incur Indebtedness or Liens, and proceeds of the JV Interests remain Collateral.
lme_vectors.basis: Amended Section 7.02 restricts new subsidiaries; the Specified Subsidiary definition carries debt and lien prohibitions enforced as an Event of Default; amended Section 7.04 bars the Specified Subsidiary from fundamental changes; the Excluded Assets proviso keeps JV proceeds as Collateral.
lme_vectors.quote: No Loan Party shall form or acquire any direct Subsidiary after the Closing Date, other than the Specified Subsidiary.

lme_vectors.rationale: The amended Restricted Payments lead-in now covers the Specified Subsidiary, but Parent is carved out and the exceptions themselves are not in the excerpt.
lme_vectors.basis: Amended lead-in to Section 7.06 covers Loan Parties other than Parent, plus the Specified Subsidiary.
lme_vectors.quote: None of any Loan Party (other than Parent) nor the Specified Subsidiary shall declare or make, directly or indirectly, any Restricted Payment, except:

lme_vectors.rationale: The excerpt sets no incremental or ratio debt capacity for the Loan Parties. It only limits the Co-Borrower/Specified SPV from consenting to debt at the Americas Styrenics JV.
lme_vectors.quote: Indebtedness not to exceed $25,000,000 in the aggregate outstanding at any time
